## Rust

The rendered rustdoc for every crate in the workspace is published under
[`api/rust/tidyrustmodels/`](api/rust/tidyrustmodels/index.html) by the site build
(`cargo doc --workspace --no-deps`). The facade crate `tidyrustmodels` re-exports the
workspace through its `prelude`; the crates behind it are `tidyrustmodels-core`
(tables, columns, design matrices, errors, seeds), `-recipes`, `-models`, `-resample`,
`-metrics`, `-workflows`, `-tune` and `-workflowsets`. Locally:

```bash
cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --open
```

## Python

The package `tidyrustmodels` re-exports the compiled extension under stable names and
adds the pandas / Arrow / Polars / SciPy conversions in Python. Every exported name,
with the first line of its docstring, generated from the package at build time:

{{< include generated/python-api.md >}}

Data conventions (from the package docstring): numeric columns are float64 with `NaN`
for missing; categorical columns are `str` labels with `None` for missing, levels sorted
bytewise like R's `factor()` in the C locale; the first level is the event level for
binary classification metrics; NumPy input is copied once into the Rust column-major
layout.
